pages.text: Randall-Sundrum: our brane sits at the end of a warped fifth dimension, and energies there are suppressed by e^(−πkr). With kr ≈ 11 the Planck scale shrinks to TeV. The brane tensions must cancel almost exactly - the cosmological-constant problem, by hand.
$(thing)Set$(): Warp k·r, Curvature k, Tension offset δ.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Tension drift: the residual vacuum energy is δ + 0.002·d. Re-tune δ to cancel it.
$(thing)Limits$(): Brane mistuned: it inflates or crunches; The rift frame is overheating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): The rift is harvested at a fixed pace.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Warp factor: w = e^(−πkr)$(br)Brane scale Λ: Λ = M_Pl·e^(−πkr)$(br)Brane scale: log₁₀ Λ$(br)First KK graviton: m₁ = 3.83·k·Λ$(br)Residual vacuum energy: Λ₄ = δ + drift
